fields.note: Under 90/95 normal tolerance statistics, three articles at 5% scatter need a mean of 0.815 to bound 0.564, and at 10% scatter it is impossible. Ten articles at 10% need 0.738. So a result counts under a validated-analysis rule: at least three articles per configuration, measured as-built shape, identified failure mode, and an elastic-plastic FE that predicts each within 10%. Precedent: NASA SBKF used 8 subscale and 2 full-scale cylinders.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
